apiContracts: Authenticated author/admin access; project ownership is checked before claim acquisition; no request-supplied owner is trusted.
Conditional D1 update grants one active token per project; token fences every late completion and generated chapter insertion.
Editing project configuration invalidates an active claim; stale claims are recoverable after 30 minutes.

migrationPlan.canonicalEntityReuse: Adds only four claim fields and one token lookup index to existing AI Author Studio tables.
migrationPlan.backwardCompatibility: Runtime schema bootstrap adds missing fields idempotently for legacy/local installs; production release must apply migration 0046 before deploying the Worker.
migrationPlan.rollbackOrForwardRepair: Forward-only; retain claim fields and clear stale tokens through a reviewed operational repair if required.

uiLifecycle.clientBootBehavior: Existing Author Studio client continues to call the same run endpoint.

privacySecurity.authorization: The authenticated project owner alone may start a generation run; admin cannot impersonate a creator. Project ownership is checked against session user before acquiring a claim.
privacySecurity.ownerScoping: All project/job mutations are scoped by project ID and token; generation run records use the authenticated project owner ID.
privacySecurity.csrf: Existing Worker same-origin POST policy remains in force.
privacySecurity.rateAndSizeLimits: Existing provider and request controls remain; one active run per project prevents concurrent duplicate generation.
privacySecurity.concurrency: Conditional UPDATE claim, unique token fencing, stale-claim expiry and D1 batch writes protect late workers.

isolation: two concurrent SQLite connections yield exactly one winner
replaced claim cannot insert a chapter or overwrite progress

flags: No new feature flag; existing AI provider configuration remains required.
stagingSteps: Run exact-head CI and concurrency regressions
Verify no production deployment until the full canonical migration release plan is approved.

rollback.codeRollback: Revert route integration while retaining additive fields and index.
rollback.dataRollbackOrForwardRepair: Do not drop claim fields; forward repair only.

changeSummary: Adds atomic token-fenced AI generation claims to prevent concurrent duplicate runs and discard late results.
acceptanceCriteria: All required workflows pass on exact head.
Migration 0046 is uniquely reserved and replayable.
Only one concurrent claim succeeds per project.
Late workers cannot insert chapters or overwrite progress after claim replacement.
No production D1 migration or Worker deployment is performed.
validationRequirement: All validation workflows must pass on the exact feature head and current integration base before this feature is merged into the canonical integration branch.
